_comment: Real rows from the 2026 data audit non-theatre accounting (BRO-4204). title/venue/category/todayTixCategory are verbatim from shows.json at audit time (venue trimmed). decision = what discovery (isNonTheaterContent, market from `market`) must do at ingest. Rows kept only because critics reviewed them (Dog Man at QEH, Silver Manhattan at Bowery Ballroom) are intentionally absent: they enter via the aggregator promoters, not discovery. See docs/show-inclusion-policy.md.
